services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Tailored support to secure and optimise your real estate projects in the UAE.
services.s1_desc: In-depth analysis of property developers (track record, financial health) and projects (escrow account, RERA approvals) before any commitment.
services.s2_desc: Review and negotiation of Sales and Purchase Agreements to protect your interests and avoid abusive clauses.
services.s3_desc: Advice on acquisition structuring (personally, via an offshore company or Freezone) based on your status as a French or Emirati tax resident.
services.s4_desc: Setting up wills (DIFC Wills) and transmission strategies to protect your UAE real estate assets.

expertises.title: A multidisciplinary competence base
expertises.intro: International real estate investment requires a comprehensive understanding of legal and tax issues, both in the country of origin and in the country of investment.
expertises.e1_desc: Understanding of double taxation prevention treaties (particularly France-UAE). Analysis of the investment's impact on your overall tax situation (income tax, wealth tax) and income repatriation strategies.
expertises.e2_desc: Assistance in creating investment structures (Freezone, Mainland, Offshore) suited to commercial or residential property acquisition, including shareholders' agreement drafting.
expertises.e3_desc: Securing transactions through meticulous contract analysis (MOU, SPA). Verification of completion guarantees and conditions precedent.

honoraires.title: Fees
honoraires.subtitle: Transparency and predictability are the cornerstones of our billing.
honoraires.consultation_desc: The first consultation allows us to assess the feasibility of your project, define the scope of our involvement and identify potential risks.
honoraires.forfait_desc: For standard real estate transactions, we offer a flat fee agreed in advance. No hourly billing surprises will be applied without your prior agreement.
honoraires.forfait_li2: Review of the reservation contract and SPA

investissement.title: Real Estate Investment in Dubai
investissement.subtitle: Understanding the market, legal framework and opportunities to invest with confidence.
investissement.p1: Dubai's real estate market is particularly dynamic and attractive, offering high rental yields and favourable taxation (no tax on rental income or capital gains).
investissement.legal_desc: The Dubai Land Department (DLD) and the Real Estate Regulatory Agency (RERA) strictly regulate transactions. For off-plan purchases, funds must be deposited into a project-specific escrow account.
investissement.why_desc: Despite this protective framework, many non-resident investors face language barriers, aggressive sales tactics from certain intermediaries, and complex contracts (SPA). Our role is to rebalance the power dynamic with the developer and ensure thorough due diligence.
investissement.cta_desc: Contact us for an initial consultation to assess your real estate project.

mentionsLegales.title: Legal Notice
mentionsLegales.s1_desc: The Odyssée Advisory website is published by Mr. Pierre Debuisson, practising as a Legal Consultant in the United Arab Emirates.
mentionsLegales.s1_address: Registered office: Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
mentionsLegales.s2_desc: The website is hosted on secure servers located in the United Arab Emirates, ensuring data protection and localisation in compliance with local regulations.
mentionsLegales.s3_desc: The information provided on this website is purely informational and educational. It does not constitute personalised legal advice or an investment offer with guaranteed returns.
mentionsLegales.s3_desc2: Odyssée Advisory acts strictly as a legal and strategic advisory firm, and does not engage in real estate brokerage or agency activities.
